dashboard.label: Brief — Agent-Readiness
dashboard.description: Per-app agent-readiness scores, updated weekly by the Brief scheduled audit.

search.query: index=brief_scores status=ok earliest=-30d | stats latest(overall_score) as score by app_name | stats avg(score) as overall_readiness | eval overall_readiness=round(overall_readiness)

index=brief_scores status=ok earliest=-30d | stats latest(overall_score) as score, latest(presence_pct) as presence, latest(quality_avg) as quality, latest(coverage_pct) as coverage, latest(safety_pct) as safety, latest(proposed_count) as proposals by app_name | sort -score | rename app_name as "App", score as "Score", presence as "Presence", quality as "Quality", coverage as "Coverage", safety as "Safety", proposals as "Proposed descriptions"

index=brief_scores status=ok earliest=-30d | stats latest(overall_score) as score, latest(presence_pct) as presence, latest(quality_avg) as quality, latest(safety_pct) as safety by app_name | sort score | head 5 | rename app_name as "App", score as "Score", presence as "Presence", quality as "Quality", safety as "Safety"

index=brief_scores status=ok earliest=-30d | stats latest(presence_pct) as Presence, latest(quality_avg) as Quality, latest(coverage_pct) as Coverage, latest(safety_pct) as Safety by app_name | sort -Presence | head 20
index=brief_scores status=ok earliest=-90d | timechart span=1d avg(overall_score) as "Overall readiness"
